 Mitchell & Hines Injury Lawyers

Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1066 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
We write on behalf of our client, Caleb Peterson, regarding the collision that
occurred on 2023-12-05. Our client was stopped at an intersection, preparing to turn
left, when the other vehicle struck the driver's side of the car. The police report and
the photographs taken at the scene support our client's account that the force of the
impact was substantial and that the at-fault driver failed to yield the right of way.
As a direct result of the collision, our client suffered a serious knee injury. Medical
records document torn ligaments and ongoing pain, swelling, and limited mobility. Our
client has undergone physical therapy and has been advised that further treatment may
be necessary. Time away from work has also reduced our client's income during
recovery.
Liability in this matter is clear. Your insured's negligence caused the crash, and
there is no reasonable basis to dispute fault. We are prepared to resolve this claim
without litigation, but only if your company responds promptly and in good faith.
Our cilent will accept the sum of $210,000.00 to settle all claims arising from this
incident. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If
we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without
further notice.
Please direct all future correspondence regarding this matter to our office.
Expert review: Anthony Davis, neurologist
Sincerely,
Nicole Arias
Mitchell & Hines Injury Lawyers
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
